record_title: Two-message Wang--Wu protocol with a polynomial one-way gap
provenance: A communication-complexity refinement of Wang--Wu, arXiv:2609.20763: reorder the Gap-Hamming sampling and fully linear-PCP response into two messages, and restrict the cheat-sheet table to embed INDEX in each one-way direction.
limitations: The one-way lower bound is not shown tight and no improvement is made to the source rectangle or adaptive-query bounds. The private-coin corollary is a standard Newman conversion. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with elevated near-simultaneous priority risk because arXiv:2609.20763 is very recent.
